description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
